Metadata.description: Alisher Zhuman (Алишер Жуманов) — Middle Frontend Developer at Tunduk, Bishkek. React, Next.js, TypeScript, Feature-Sliced Design.

Hero.windowClosed: Happy at the club, but will listen to offers

Hero.quoteSource: — a source close to the player

Card.title: Player card
Card.lead: Tap or click the card to flip it.
bio: From Talas, lives in Bishkek. Middle Frontend Developer at Tunduk.
Graduated from college in information security, so he thinks not only about how a form looks but also about what someone might send through it. Now studying business informatics at university.
Has already closed backend tasks on a work project — and liked it. Wants to make that position his own.

Scout.title: Scouting report
Scout.strengths: Careful typing, layouts that fit any screen, accessible interfaces, fast-loading pages, Feature-Sliced Design architecture and an eye for form security.
Scout.growing: Backend: Node.js and NestJS, Java, SQL and PostgreSQL, API design and working with databases.
Scout.note: Sometimes sweats the small stuff: a stray pixel in the layout, a variable name. The coaching staff ask him not to hold on to the ball.

Match.title: Career as a match
Match.lead: Scroll down: the clock on the scoreboard runs with you.
fouls: Yellow card to Bugs for diving: “works on my machine”.
Second yellow, that’s red! Bugs are sent off. Until the next release.
Bugs are already in the dressing room. The referee asks not to disturb them.
commentary: Alisher beats three bugs and is one on one with production!
The referee shows a yellow card for !important in CSS.
VAR is checking: bug or feature? Feature. Play on.
Trusts the team, but re-checks staging after them — and is right more often than the backend would like.
The coach shouts from the touchline: “Type it!”
The ball hits the post. The post turns out to be legacy code.
Match stats: zero console.log in production. Almost.
Match.varDone: Goal stands: no offside, commit signed.

kickoff.title: Kick-off: in IT since 14
kickoff.text: First code, long before the first job.

academy.title: Peaksoft academy
academy.text: Front-end courses: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React. First training projects.

peaksoft.title: First-team debut: Peaksoft
peaksoft.text: Intern, then Junior Frontend. A gadget store, clinic bookings, an English testing platform. Taught students on the side.

codify.title: Transfer to Codify Lab
codify.text: Lead author of Codify GO: interactive coding lessons, points and levels, certificates, payments. Plus a student LMS and reports for curators.

clickfood.title: Transfer to ClickFood
clickfood.text: Middle Frontend. Food delivery as a Telegram Mini App: catalogue and cart for customers, a restaurant dashboard, reports for accounting.

tunduk.title: Middle Frontend Developer at Tunduk
tunduk.text: E-Accreditation: the public portal and the staff dashboard, almost entirely on his own.

assist.title: Moves the team
assist.text: Gathers the requirements for the backend, chases design and testing. When the team isn’t around, he’s his own designer, backend and analyst.

kuttukTime.title: Solo run: KuttukTime
kuttukTime.text: His own product: gift certificates from local businesses in a Telegram Mini App. Front end and backend entirely his own, with online payments.

substitution.title: Substitution: on in a backend role
substitution.text: In progress… Java, Node.js, NestJS, SQL and PostgreSQL.

Projects.title: Projects
Projects.lead: What he has worked on, club by club.
Projects.pageLead: Every project, club by club: from the first training ones to today’s.
Projects.metaDescription: Projects by Alisher Zhuman (Алишер Жуманов): GovTech, food delivery, EdTech, IoT and his own product. React, Next.js, TypeScript.

kca.title: Kyrgyz Center of Accreditation
kca.description: E-Accreditation: a public portal with registries and news, and a staff dashboard with step-by-step applications and access roles.
did: Public portal on Next.js: static generation, SEO markup, dark theme, Kyrgyz and Russian.
Staff dashboard on React and MUI: data tables, validated step-by-step forms, a rich text editor.
Feature-Sliced Design with automated checks, tests in Vitest and Playwright.

kuttukTime.description: A gift certificate for a coffee shop, spa or salon with no sign-up: the code can be sent to a friend and the merchant redeems it in their dashboard. Includes an admin for merchants and categories.
did: Backend on NestJS and PostgreSQL: sign-in via the Telegram signature, JWT and roles.
Payments through Finik: signed requests, verified webhooks, repeated deliveries never double-charge.
The React Mini App: buying a certificate, a code to share, the partner dashboard.

kiu.description: Site and CMS for the Kyrgyz Islamic University in three languages: news, faculties, timetables and a section for applicants. Staff manage the content themselves.
did: Engineered a trilingual SEO-optimized platform (KG/RU/EN) using next-intl, dynamic hreflang sitemaps, and locale-aware Axios interceptors, achieving top-tier Lighthouse scores (99 Performance, 100 SEO/Accessibility).

Developed a comprehensive multi-language Admin CMS empowering university staff to manage dynamic content (news, schedules, faculty directories) and securely upload assets directly to AWS S3, reducing content publishing cycle times by 80%.

Accelerated Time-to-First-Byte (TTFB) and search engine indexing for applicants by implementing a hybrid rendering strategy combining server-side React Query prefetching with client-side dashboard caching.
Enforced strict architectural discipline across a 300+ file codebase using Feature-Sliced Design (FSD) to maintain unidirectional data flow, strict layer separation, and reusable domain primitives.

bilimBulak.description: A psychological diagnostics platform for teachers, built for the Ministry of Education and the Teachers’ Union: tests, burnout detection and personal recommendations.
did: Developed critical national digital infrastructure for psychological health in partnership with the Ministry of Education, scaling across 2,000+ educational institutions nationwide with a 98% test completion rate.

Engineered fault-tolerant diagnostic flows preventing data loss during technical failures via local persistence, strict clinical one-attempt policies, automated timeout submissions, and rigorous schema validation (React Hook Form + Zod).
Implemented robust locale-first routing (KG/RU) via next-intl, maintaining synchronized language context across client views, form validations, and dedicated regional API endpoints.

Designed a complex multi-step onboarding system featuring a 4-level cascading geographical dropdown structure (Region, District, Org Type, Institution) powered by dependent React Query hooks and secure OTP authentication.

quant.description: Smart water meters: a landing page in three languages and a dispatcher dashboard with consumption charts and remote valve control.
did: Expanded IoT product market reach by implementing a trilingual ecosystem (RU/KG/EN) using next-intl, locale-first routing, dynamic sitemap generation with hreflang alternates, and robust OpenGraph metadata.

Optimized landing page performance and Time-to-Interactive (TTI) by strategically applying Next.js dynamic imports, lazy loading for heavy modules, optimized WebP/video assets, and custom scroll restoration hooks.

Engineered a real-time dispatcher dashboard for water infrastructure control, integrating Recharts for time-series consumption analytics, remote valve management commands, and hover-intent React Query prefetching.

Scaled both the public landing and the administration cabinet using a clean, multi-layered architecture featuring Feature-Sliced Design (FSD) for stateful views, Atomic Design, and strict type-safe internationalization.

clickfood.description: Food delivery in Telegram: restaurant search sorted by distance, a cart with modifiers, promo codes and cashback, and a partner dashboard with a stop list.
did: Scaled a high-load Telegram Mini App for food delivery servicing 30k+ active users and 150+ partner restaurants using React 19, TypeScript, and native Telegram WebApp SDK integration.

Designed a modular, maintainable frontend architecture utilizing Feature-Sliced Design (FSD), type-safe data fetching via React Query, runtime schema validation with Zod, and strategic code splitting.
Engineered a complex multi-step checkout flow handling dynamic dish modifiers, promo engines, cashback logic, auto-fill, and Yandex Map API delivery zone validation.
Built high-performance restaurant discovery utilizing Turf.js for client-side geospatial sorting, infinite scrolling, and optimized debounced search queries.
Eliminated scroll jank and achieved smooth 60fps performance in large dish catalogs by synchronizing section navigation via IntersectionObserver.
Developed a full-featured B2B partner dashboard featuring real-time stop-list management, POS iiko integration, sales analytics, and strict role-based access control.
Established a robust, decoupled state management strategy for persistent carts, multi-shop address handling, and secure token injection, eliminating session desynchronization.

turan.description: An admin panel for smart meters: users, devices, readings, remote water shut-off, access roles and Excel import.
did: Eliminated physical site visits for utility operators by engineering a secure remote valve control system coupled with a granular 4-tier Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) architecture.
Streamlined heavy operational workflows by implementing bulk device data import via Excel spreadsheets and robust, URL-synchronized search/filter state management.

Ensured a responsive real-time dashboard under high-frequency meter reading updates by implementing differentiated React Query caching strategies, pagination state preservation, and strict runtime Zod validation.
Optimized production bundle delivery and long-term codebase scalability through strategic Vite vendor chunk splitting and a decoupled domain architecture utilizing Feature-Sliced Design (FSD).

billingCenter.description: Utility bills paid in four steps: provider, account number, amount due and a QR payment. Plain JavaScript, without a single library.
did: Moved utility bill payments to online format: implemented 4-step self-service flow (provider selection → account entry → debt display → QR payment) with deeplink to banking apps and payment validation; reduced time-to-payment by 35%, cut payment errors by 42%.

Consolidated 3 utility providers into single interface: implemented provider-selection with POST request to billing API (ners.billing.kg), instant debt, address, and period display; PDF invoice downloaded without support calls (Vodkanal, Teploset, Tazalyk).

Ensured reliability without external dependencies: implemented fully functional SPA in vanilla JavaScript (Fetch API, DOM manipulation) with zero npm packages; 13 KB JS + 11 KB CSS bundle, local fonts without CDN, zero technical debt.

Implemented accessibility and cross-platform support: modal meets ARIA standards (aria-modal, aria-labelledby), closes on Escape; PDF opens in new tab on desktop and downloads on mobile; increased mobile payment success by 27%, first-attempt completion by 18%.

codifyLms.description: CRM and LMS for training centres: homework with a code editor, leaderboards and coins, reports to parents over WhatsApp.
did: Automated personalized monthly parent reports: implemented Smart Reports system with phone validation, editable table via TanStack React Table + React Hook Form, and retry mechanism for WhatsApp; educators see communication gaps before sending; reduced reporting time by 50%.

Shortened mentor-student feedback cycle on assignments: implemented task submission with TipTap WYSIWYG editor (syntax highlighting for HTML/CSS/JS/Python), 75MB file uploads, solution history with statuses, and mentor comments with avatars; instant redirect with earned Code Coins; increased completion by 30%.

Increased daily student engagement through competitive gamification: implemented local leaderboards (top-10 per course) and global with 60-second auto-rotation, progress connection line via custom hook; PostHog event tracking; increased engagement and retention by 30%.

Expanded learning formats without bundle bloat: implemented 4 types of digital literacy activities (vocabulary flashcards, picture quiz MCQ, drag-drop with Web Speech API text-to-speech, theory with tooltips); Feature-Sliced Design, Next.js 15 / Vite + React 19 + TypeScript strict + Zustand + SWR.

codifyGo.description: Micro-lessons in HTML, CSS and cybersecurity: a code editor right in the browser, levels and streaks, a subscription and an olympiad for schoolchildren.
did: Increased daily student activity through multi-level gamification: implemented XP progression with level-up notifications, Code Coins exchangeable for merchandise (stickers, socks, backpacks), activity streaks, and daily goals; React Circular Progressbar + SWR caching; increased engagement by 30%.

Monetized content through Stripe subscription without losing free-tier users: implemented checkout (monthly/yearly with 17% savings badge), paywall for Pro lessons, promocode system with auto-renewal; subscription status checked in root layout shows upgrade prompt at right moment.

Lowered entry barrier to zero through in-browser code editor: embedded CodeMirror 6 with live iframe-preview of HTML/CSS, file tabs, and theme-aware syntax highlighting - students write, see preview, and submit assignments without IDE installation; improved comprehension speed by 10%.

Expanded reach to Kyrgyzstan school students through Codify Balajan Olympiad: implemented enrollment (name, school, grade 1–11, region from 7 provinces), anti-duplicate checking, and PDF certificates with QR via client-side jsPDF; scales without backend load.

virtualAccelerate.description: A platform for accelerators: startup selection on a kanban board, investor voting, a form builder and 8 languages including RTL.
did: Replaced Excel and emails with unified Kanban tool for startup selection: developed Selection Board with drag-drop, bulk operations, scoring forms, and comments - entire selection cycle in one interface; multi-tenant architecture.

Accelerated investment decisions and eliminated ad-hoc communication: implemented Deal Flow pipeline with analyst assignment, investor voting, and Approval Committee workflow - every decision is documented and formally approved.
Opened platform to Central Asia and Middle East markets: implemented support for 8 languages (EN, RU, KY, TG, UR, SY, AR, PT) with RTL rendering; granular permissions for 5+ roles via CASL.

Eliminated developer dependency for form and analytics creation: implemented no-code Form Builder with drag-drop fields + Analytics Dashboard with 6 role-based tabs (Program, Business, Investment, Learning, Team, Reports) via Apexcharts/Recharts.

jobCodify.description: A careers platform: jobs, courses, an AI résumé helper and a sandbox for running code in the browser.
did: Optimized technical job discovery by engineering a multi-dimensional filtering system backed by Redux state management, dynamic API query generation, and persistent SSR hydration states.

Architected a multi-sided marketplace platform supporting dual-role workflows for job seekers and employers across diverse service verticals (jobs, freelance, courses, events) utilizing role-based SSG/SSR and PWA offline capabilities.

Developed an in-browser code execution sandbox integrating Monaco and CodeMirror editors, client-side runners (`react-runner` for JS/React, `react-py` for Python), console output capture, and interactive learning pipelines.

Engineered a robust authentication and session-recovery workflow utilizing NextAuth.js (Google, Telegram, credentials) with a queue-based API interceptor for silent token refreshing without user disruption, paired with Sentry error monitoring.

codifyAcademy.description: A site for programming, design and management courses for children and adults: enrolment, a free lesson and a career aptitude test.
did: Maximized lead capture through 5 conversion points: implemented FindEducation form on hero, EnrollForCourse in footer, free lesson registration, PDF checklist download, and 3-step career aptitude test; context-aware messages based on business hours - each user receives relevant response without manual triage.

Reduced off-target bounce through segmented funnels: developed isolated pages for adults (JS, Java, Python, QA, UX/UI, PM) and children 7–17 (CODIFY Kids); international phone validation via libphonenumber-js reduces invalid leads.

Accelerated Time-to-Interactive using Svelte + Sapper instead of React: zero runtime overhead, WebP images with fetchpriority="high" on hero and loading="lazy" on others; GA4 and Facebook Pixel load only after user interaction.

Eliminated content update dependency on developers: all content (partners, employer logos, testimonials, FAQ) loaded from Django REST API via Axios; content manager updates data in CMS without redeploys; i18next localization for RU/EN.

codifyTeens.description: A landing page for a coding academy for ages 7–17 in three languages: a fee calculator, a map and an application form.
did: Built high-performance academy landing page from scratch using Next.js and Tailwind CSS: SSR for meta tags in 3 languages (RU / EN / KY) ensures high SEO visibility.
Optimized layout for mobile and desktop, reducing bounce rate by 20%: media queries and dynamic components via Framer Motion for smooth experience across all devices.
Increased user engagement: integrated Yandex Maps for school location, embedded Instagram feed for social proof, added interactive tuition cost calculator.

Increased lead conversion by 15%: developed application form with real-time validation via React Hook Form, automatic confirmation, and gift notification push upon registration; backend API integration for lead persistence.

startupNation.description: The landing page of Central Asia’s largest hackathon: registration, speakers, mentors and the prize fund.
did: Boosted registration conversion by developing a high-performance event landing page featuring dynamic API-driven content and a multi-tier partner showcase.

Extended platform lifecycle into a long-term learning ecosystem by architecting a comprehensive LMS dashboard (20+ views including courses, quizzes, assignments, and forums) with an integrated shopping cart.
Minimized Time-to-Interactive (TTI) for a graphically heavy site (GSAP parallax, Particles.js) using Next.js 13 Server/Client component separation and advanced asset optimization.
Streamlined dynamic content updates by implementing a centralized Axios wrapper architecture for seamless REST API consumption.

codifyLab.description: A development studio’s site: case studies and services from a CMS, a brief form with attachments, Russian and English.
did: Expanded reach to English-speaking clients without manual language selection: integrated i18next with browser-languagedetector - visitors see site in their language automatically; language passed to API requests for localized content (RU/EN) without code duplication.

Eliminated portfolio dependency on developers: all dynamic content (case studies, services, technologies) loaded from API via Axios - manager adds project to CMS, it instantly appears in React Slick carousel; useMemo prevents unnecessary re-renders on language switch.

Increased lead quality through detailed project brief in form: implemented multi-field contact form (name, email, industry, budget, timeline, description) with file upload for requirements via FormData; animated success message confirms submission without page reload.

Prevented mobile lead loss through 10 responsive breakpoints (1150px to 311px): responsive workflow-timeline, mobile menu with overlay, touch-friendly carousel; Web Vitals monitoring (CLS, LCP, FCP, FID) ensures production performance.

alphaCargo.description: Cargo between Kyrgyzstan and Russia: shipment tracking by waybill, a rate calculator and a contract wizard for businesses.
did: Reduced support load from status inquiries: implemented tracking page with timeline visualization, debounced search by waybill number, and shareable URL - customers send link to recipients with pre-filled tracking, eliminating calls to manager.

Increased conversion through instant cost calculation: developed tariff calculator (origin city, cargo type) with real-time useMemo-filtered tariff rates - customers see exact price and delivery timeframe before booking; covers B2C shippers + e-commerce (Wildberries/Ozon).

Automated waybill issuance: implemented base64 PDF to Blob conversion via react-pdf with adaptive behavior (desktop = embedded viewer, mobile = forced download); customers receive documents instantly from dashboard without support requests.

Accelerated corporate client onboarding for LTL services: developed 4-step contract wizard (Service → Cargo → Parameters → Agreement) with React Hook Form + TypeScript validation; ModalManagerProvider (Context) manages 10+ modal types without prop drilling; libphonenumber-js phone validation.

shine.description: An admin panel for an aesthetic clinic: doctors, procedures, reviews and news with a rich text editor.
did: Developed secure admin panel for clinic content management: implemented JWT authentication with protected routes and role-based access control for administrators.

Simplified doctor and procedure management: implemented full CRUD for 50+ doctors and 100+ medical procedures with categorization, descriptions, and portfolio photo uploads; doctor form includes qualifications, certifications, and experience.
Accelerated clinic content management by 40%: implemented patient reviews, news, and pages management with rich text editor (CKEditor5) and bulk image uploads via react-dropzone.

Reduced category management errors by 30%: implemented dynamic category system with multi-input fields for related procedures, before/after photos, and 3-tier pricing; React Hook Form + Yup validation prevents duplicates.

peaksoftHouse.description: An IT course site: online enrolment, course pages, student projects and an admin panel for two offices.
did: Increased lead capture through multi-channel conversion system: implemented countdown timer, modal forms via createPortal, floating WhatsApp button, and toast notifications - potential students submit applications from anywhere; backend API integration with multipart upload and Bearer token auth.

Built trust and reduced bounce rate: implemented CountUp animations for key metrics (100+ graduates, 300+ active students, 70% employment rate), Swiper coverflow 3D team carousel, and 8+ testimonials with job positions and employers of alumni.

Eliminated marketing dependency on developers: built Admin Panel with CRUD management for banners and promotions, separate roles for two offices (Bishkek / Moscow) - marketing manager updates campaigns independently without redeploys.

Accelerated page load and improved SEO visibility: leveraged Next.js 13 SSR, next/image lazy loading, AWS S3 CDN for 105+ images, Framer Motion scroll animations without layout thrashing; meta tags in 3 languages (KY/RU/EN) + GA4 + CircleCI deployment.

bilingual.description: English testing: 9 question types, voice recording and anti-cheating protection.
did: Expanded language testing to cover all 4 skills in single interface: implemented 9 question types with dynamic component loading, Web Audio API for audio recording with waveform visualization, transcription, and word-count validation.

Reduced cheating attempts: implemented multi-level anti-cheat protection - PrintScreen blocking, tab-switch detection via Visibility API (4 violations → force test completion), and beforeunload warning; all using native Browser APIs without third-party proctoring.

Eliminated progress loss on page refresh: implemented dual storage strategy (Redux + sessionStorage) with incremental answer saving - test resumes from checkpoint without data loss on technical failures.

Increased sign-up rate by 15%: implemented Google OAuth authentication with smooth Framer Motion animations; developed Admin evaluation pipeline with unified interface for viewing and grading all answer formats with automatic email results.

airbnb.description: Home rentals in Kyrgyzstan: filters and search, moderated listings, favourites.
did: Reduced time-to-find accommodation by 25%: implemented multi-filter system (region, type, price, rating, geolocation) with debounced real-time search (500ms) - API requests reduced by 10x; chip-based filter removal.

Simplified listing process for hosts: developed form with up to 4 photo uploads, 8 Kyrgyzstan region selection, React Hook Form + Yup validation, and status system (APPROVED / ON_MODERATION / BLOCKED).
Accelerated moderation for admins: implemented Admin Dashboard with request queue, approve/reject workflow with personalized rejection messages, and bulk operations (block/delete).
Increased sign-up rate by 15% and improved retention: integrated Google OAuth via Firebase (one-click registration), added favorites system with toggle synchronization, and role-based code splitting.

healthCheck.description: A medical service: booking a doctor in five steps, test results online and doctors’ schedules for the admin.
did: Reduced patient appointment booking cycle and eliminated lost requests: implemented 5-step appointment flow (select department → doctor → date → time → verification) with Admin Dashboard queue for tracking each application.
Simplified doctor schedule management: developed Schedule Dashboard with bulk time-slot operations, debounced doctor search, and specialist status management for 30+ doctors.
Reduced unnecessary consultations: implemented catalog of 22 medical specialties with descriptions, 3-tier pricing, and doctor filtering - patients see exact cost before booking.

Ensured secure access to medical data: implemented role-based routing with Google OAuth and email/password authentication via Firebase; Excel reports for admins and PDF functionality for test results.

peaksoftLms.description: A platform for managing courses, students and teachers: editors for course materials, graded assignments and importing students from Excel.
did: Lowered barrier to content creation for teachers: implemented flexible system of 3 rich text editors (CKEditor5, TipTap, Lexical) for different formats; added drag-and-drop file uploads, video, presentations, and external links support.
Accelerated admin workflow by 30%: implemented bulk student import via Excel, soft delete system (trash) for safe deletion, and flexible group management with course assignment and access control.
Automated assignment checking and grading: implemented assignment management, automated grading, and real-time progress tracking for 2,000+ students.
Increased student engagement by 40%: optimized interface clarity and usability, added interactive tests, collaborative tasks, and analytics for progress tracking.

gadgetarium.description: An online gadget store: catalogue, comparison, wishlist, Stripe checkout and a product admin.
did: Reduced cart abandonment: implemented Stripe checkout with auto-fill, real-time validation via Formik + Yup.
Accelerated catalog load time by 60%: leveraged code splitting with React.lazy() + debounced search, skeleton screens, and 96+ memoizations.
Simplified product management for team: built Admin Dashboard with bulk operations, multi-step wizard, and drag-and-drop image uploads.
Increased retention: implemented wishlist, browsing history, product comparison, and smart recommendations with Redux Persist.
